race.comment: MAYLEIGH (5) overcame an awkward start to rattle home for third when resuming over this course and distance a fortnight ago. Looks to be back better than ever - no surprise if she took this out. LOREAL BELLE (2) led but didn't offer much in the run home in a 1300m Hawkesbury maiden recently. Fitter for two runs back and might be tough to catch if able to dictate. VISION IN A DREAM (4) returns after a 20-week spell. Best of four runs in the maiden prep was a placing over the mile at Newcastle. Two recent trials should have her up to the mark. MOORDYUP (7) is next best first-up from a six-month spell.
